Question:
Provide the full names of drivers who have been overtaken on track more times than they have overtaken others on track during race laps, excluding position changes due to pit stops (both at pit entry and exit), retirements, or position changes that occurred during the first lap of a race (considered as start movements).

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH position_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        l1.race_id,
        l1.driver_id,
        l1.lap as change_lap,
        CASE WHEN l2.position > l1.position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as overtaken,
        CASE WHEN l2.position < l1.position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as overtook
    FROM lap_positions l1
    JOIN lap_positions l2 ON l1.race_id = l2.race_id AND l1.driver_id = l2.driver_id AND l1.lap + 1 = l2.lap
    WHERE l1.lap_type = 'Race' AND l2.lap_type = 'Race' AND l1.position != l2.position
    AND l1.lap > 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_changes, SUM(overtaken) as overtaken, SUM(overtook) as overtook
FROM position_changes
WHERE race_id = 841 AND driver_id = 1

total_changes,overtaken,overtook

    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
lap_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        lp.race_id,
        lp.driver_id,
        lp.lap,
        lp.position,
        LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_position,
        LAG(lp.lap) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_lap,
        pl.lap AS pit_lap,
        rl.lap AS retirement_lap,
        sl.lap AS starting_lap
    FROM lap_positions lp
    LEFT JOIN pit_laps pl ON lp.race_id = pl.race_id AND lp.driver_id = pl.driver_id AND lp.lap = pl.lap
    LEFT JOIN lap_positions rl ON lp.race_id = rl.race_id AND lp.driver_id = rl.driver_id AND lp.lap = rl.lap
    LEFT JOIN lap_positions sl ON lp.race_id = sl.race_id AND lp.driver_id = sl.driver_id AND lp.lap = sl.lap
    WHERE lp.lap > 0
    AND lp.lap_type::TEXT NOT LIKE '%Retirement%'
    AND lp.lap_type::TEXT NOT LIKE '%Starting Position%'
    AND lp.position IS NOT NULL
)
